# Fourth Set notice

Set 4 uses three source geometries with the approved Tight background-tile presentation:

- Set 1 `S11` Vertical Ledger;
- Set 2 `S202` Column Relay;
- Set 3 `S301` Humanist Smooth.

The archived Color Font v1 map supplies letter backgrounds. Lowercase aliases uppercase. Every supported digit and punctuation mark uses a white background. SPACE draws neither tile nor glyph. Visible glyphs use whichever of black or white has the higher WCAG 2.x contrast against the tile.

Color map ID: `inshell.colorfont.v1`  
Canonical SHA-256: `640800ed78bee95fa828d7219ab1711a8fc8177f0af18fa590af85602e297107`  
Current THOUGHT V2 protocol dependency: **no**

Humanist Smooth is a renamed modified derivative based on Adobe Source Code Pro reference outlines and remains subject to the SIL Open Font License 1.1 reproduced in `LICENSE-OFL.md`. Vertical Ledger, Column Relay, the Set 4 renderer, palette material, package metadata, and THOUGHT/Inshell names are not relicensed by that component license. See `UNLICENSED.md`.
